title: The Picnic Cloth Bigger Than the Plan
youtube_title: The Picnic Cloth Bigger Than the Plan | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: What is split with care does not become less important.
summary: At a school cloakroom and the lunch mats just beyond, Anil sees that a picnic cloth bigger than the plan will not feel fair if only one person is served first. Anil makes a smaller, even share so Haru is included, and Uncle Idris lets the choice stand without a speech.
